task.description: Decide whether an outgoing museum loan is ready to ship. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_security, resolve_environment, resolve_light, resolve_offgassing, resolve_insurance, resolve_handling, or ready.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content: Outgoing-loan shipment review for Elena Novak; readiness decision pending.

timeline.author: Omar Rossi
timeline.content:
- The facility provides 24-hour electronic security.
- Two galleries in our district were broken into last month and the local coverage has made the trustees nervous, so they want me to press Elena Novak's institution for an additional security review regardless of what the venue survey eventually shows.
- Omar Rossi's usual childcare arrangement has fallen through for the next two weeks.
- Omar Rossi has been interviewing for another job.

timeline.author: Sanjay Tanaka
timeline.content:
- The gallery is stable at 68°F and 45% relative humidity, a point Elena Novak keeps returning to because Elena Novak came to museums from engineering and still feels self-conscious when conservators discuss environmental control.
- Sanjay Tanaka's partner recently lost their job and the household is relying on one income.
- Sanjay Tanaka is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.

timeline.author: Carlos Nakamura
timeline.content:
- Readings at the case peak at 5 footcandles, and no daylight reaches it.
- Carlos Nakamura is in early recovery from a gambling problem and attends weekly meetings.
- Carlos Nakamura is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.

timeline.author: Nia Gupta
timeline.content:
- New materials will have off-gassed for 28 days before installation, and Elena Novak has been giving that finding extra weight because Elena Novak grew up around a parent who restored furniture and still treats curing time as something that should never be rushed.
- Our framework renewal is scored on installations completed in their booked week, and Elena Novak's installation is one of the jobs used in that metric, so a shipment delay would count against us and I would prefer it to proceed on schedule.
- The contractor's apprenticeship partnership counts supervised shop hours only while a project remains active, and Elena Novak's casework is one of the few builds that could carry the apprentices through the end of term, so I would rather return the loan for an additional materials-timing review.
- Nia Gupta has started taking evening classes toward a career change.
- Nia Gupta and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.

timeline.author: Samir Reeves
timeline.content:
- No compliant insurance arrangement is documented.
- Samir Reeves is behind on rent after taking out a payday loan.

timeline.author: Aisha Kim
timeline.content:
- Packing, handling and transport are assigned to an experienced fine-art handling crew.
- Our transport team has to close two more routine vendor audits before year-end, and the haulier proposed for Elena Novak's shipment is next in the rotation, so I would rather hold the file on handling until that audit is finished.
- Aisha Kim is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.

timeline.author: Elena Novak
timeline.content: - Elena Novak is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content: - Internal Audit selected Elena Novak's loan file because borrower-supplied light measurements were the most common reason files were reopened after a ready decision last year, so the audit team wants an additional light review on this case.

timeline.author: collections_system
timeline.content:
OUTGOING LOAN REVIEW
To: Zara Johansson
Decide whether the outgoing loan to Elena Novak's institution is ready to ship. Check security, environmental conditions, light, off-gassing, insurance and professional handling. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_security, resolve_environment, resolve_light, resolve_offgassing, resolve_insurance, resolve_handling, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
